   Owner-approved method change (2026-09-30), from the owner's lessons on a research thread about smelling geosmin and
   humic acid. Forum vocabulary starts with the words people use for natural exposures and labels natural sources as
   proxy evidence; purity is separated from exposure realism, and delivery analogies must match; onset timing prunes
   mechanisms without choosing one; familiar deflationary explanations need discriminating evidence
   (NoFavoredExplanationPrivilege); route and physiological or pharmacological state are probed and tabulated; rescue,
   enhancement, state transition and cognitive domains are separate endpoints; state dependence and cross-brand
   reproduction are their own mechanistic evidence; new history reruns the whole constraint map; and a decisive user-only
   question is asked before a mechanism is elaborated.

  <Rule name="NoFavoredExplanationPrivilege" priority="Critical">
   Give familiar deflationary explanations the same scrutiny. Sensory, expectancy, placebo, anti-inflammatory, and
   pharmacokinetic accounts are competing hypotheses, not defaults: each must fit every constraint and pass
   discriminating tests, such as unrelated tastes and smells, other routes, touch, skin sensitivity, odorless materials,
   other brands or batches, and pharmacological state. Skepticism discriminates hypotheses; it does not replace
   investigation.
  </Rule>
